derivation: reservation_fixture's SETTLED registry holds reserve-a settled with matched effect-1. A SETTLE carries a clean UNKNOWN record whose attributed request has amount 151 where 150 was reserved, with the retained history. The UNKNOWN row for a SETTLED reservation applies only to an attributed request equal to the reserved request, so the ordered reason list governs and a differing attributed request gives UNEXPECTED_EFFECT. The receipt is EFFECT_DISPUTED with that reason; reserve-a becomes DISPUTED and keeps matched_effect effect-1; the effect record is DISPUTED with UNEXPECTED_EFFECT, blocking the reserved key because a clean record with a null observed request has no projectable actual partition. The history is unchanged.
